title: K-beauty: How South Korea took over skin care
主要内容: K-beauty has become a dominant force in the global skin care industry, with South Korea playing a significant role. The beauty industry's revenue is projected to exceed $379 billion within the next four years, according to an IBISWorld report, with skin care being a major contributor to this growth. Major brands such as Kylie Skin and Sephora have expanded their product lines to include skin care, while even companies like Amazon and Canopy Growth have entered the market. This trend highlights the increasing importance of skin care within the beauty sector and the global influence of K-beauty.
